raw_runs.scope: Paired debug-library helper microprobe; no production or competitive-speed claim

verification.coverage: Exact scalar bits including signed zero, NaN payloads and infinities; negative/invalid indexes; stale handles; owned values; VM/interpreter/JIT snapshots and error parity.

limitations: Seven alternating sequential samples on a loaded laptop, no concurrent task builds during measurement. Probe executable optimized, linked Kujo library debug-built.
Initial scalar-only candidate made owned-array median 2.87% slower; refined candidate removes redundant lookup. Original diagnostic retained at /tmp/kujo-scalar-read-paired.json.
All150 release test-size checksums on d777339 predate this candidate. Current release, production, competitive and portability acceptance remain open.

reproduction.probe: probes/native_indexed_read.rs directly exercises the Rust native helper ABI; link each revision library with rustc --edition=2021 -O --extern kujo=<rlib> -L dependency=<deps> and native link directories from Cargo build outputs.
